t_start.data_reference: first pulse after 10 ms at rest

period.data_reference: 20 Hz train (a high sympathetic firing rate)

i_amplitude.data_reference: suprathreshold: -1 nA (the soma takes I_in as an outward current, so a depolarising pulse is negative) fires one action potential per pulse

V_P.data_reference: the varicosity volume Vol (k_V d^3 at the defaults)

M.data_reference: no clearance but NET (in the varicosity)

J_in.data_reference: unconnected sum: 0 keeps the model as before

J_out.data_reference: unconnected sum: 0 keeps the model as before
